label: v1.6.0
headline: AnyRouter 1.6: name a model family, always get a live model
summary: Send a -latest id and AnyRouter calls the newest available model in that family. This release also adds new models, in-place BYOK key replacement, a read-only analytics scope for management keys, and a redesigned site.

highlights.line: -latest aliases such as google/gemini-flash-latest resolve to the newest live model in a family. They are listed in /api/v1/models and have their own model pages.
New in the catalog: GPT-6.1 Sol and Step 5 Preview, plus a DeepInfra route for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
Replace a BYOK key in place and keep its id, label and routing settings. anyr byok rotate antigravity re-uploads a refreshed token for you.
A new read-only read:analytics scope lets a management key read /analytics/* and nothing else.
A client hanging up no longer cools a route or sidelines your BYOK key, and routes that support reasoning are preferred.
The new SLM Matrix mini-app ranks small models by task. The landing, pricing, models and apps pages share a new print-style design.
